summary: 1U XE9712 sled for the IR9048 Open Rack v3, with two NVIDIA Grace processors and four Blackwell Ultra GPUs.

formFactor.value: 1U sled. IR9048 is a 48U OCP Open Rack v3. The sheet defines 1 RU as 44.45 mm high and 482.6 mm wide.

value.cpuMemory: 480 GB LPDDR5 with ECC per CPU
value.coherent: 900 GB/s of coherent memory through NVLink CPU-GPU interconnect

accelerators.note: The specification sheet does not publish a per-GPU wattage for this population. None is inferred.

value.front: Up to 8 x EDSFF E1.S hot-swappable NVMe
value.controller: Direct NVMe using CX8 mezzanine PCIe

value.pcie: Up to 2 x16 FHHL Gen5 front risers and 2 mezzanine Gen5/Gen6

value.rackPower: IR9048 power shelf PS33 is 33 kW and supports 6 x 5500 W AC PSUs, supplying up to 54 VDC on the rack bus bar
value.note: 33 kW and 5500 W are rack power-shelf ratings, not the XE9712 sled load. Sled planning watts were not on the extracted sheet.

support.note: Lifecycle dates were not retrieved. The sheet lists Ubuntu and points at Dell OS support for interoperability.

firmwareBaseline.reason: No BMC, iDRAC, or GPU driver version is included.

referenceConfigurations.title: XE9712 sled with four Blackwell Ultra GPUs
referenceConfigurations.note: Published sled description. The IR9048 rack population count is not stated in the extract and is not invented.
